The X-GitHub-Event header (which determines whether Core treats a delivery as push vs create/delete, and therefore whether classify_ingestion_envelope ultimately sees repo.push vs repo.branch) is not itself covered by GitHub's X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC (GitHub signs only the raw body). This is a pre-existing characteristic of GitHub's webhook protocol, unrelated to and unchanged by this diff. Exploiting it requires an active network position between GitHub and Core, outside this diff's threat model. Recorded for completeness, not as a diff-attributable finding.
